Package hkust.marketplace.model

Class Deal

java.lang.Object
hkust.marketplace.model.Deal
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Deal extends Object implements Serializable
A buyer's offer, borrow request or claim on one listing, from submission until it is finished. The record of all deals and each buyer's deal history are deals with a finished status.
